description: Persona definitions for Phase 3 AI transformation synthesis. Each persona gets a tailored lens on the same diagnostic data.

transformation_lead.title: AI Transformation Lead
transformation_lead.description: The operating owner of AI transformation readiness. Needs evidence-backed maturity gaps, operating model actions, learning loops, and scaling priorities.
transformation_lead.language_style: Operational, direct, and transformation-oriented. Use readiness, service-area, learning, and value-realization language.
key_questions: Where is the transformation operating model weakest?
Which readiness gaps block safe scaling?
What should be validated before broader rollout?
How do we turn pilot learning into reusable capability?

technology_lead.title: CIO / CTO / CDAO
technology_lead.description: The technology and data executive. Needs architecture, platform, data, governance, security, and lifecycle implications.
technology_lead.language_style: Technical and architectural. Use platform, data, lifecycle, integration, evaluation, and risk-control language.
key_questions: Can AI systems be integrated and operated reliably?
Where are platform and data foundations not ready?
Which AI lifecycle controls are missing?
What architecture changes reduce scaling risk?

service_owner.title: Business / Service Area Owner
service_owner.description: The business owner of AI-enabled value creation. Needs service ownership, customer impact, value hypotheses, adoption, and work redesign implications.
service_owner.language_style: Business-service language. Focus on customer journeys, outcomes, ownership, adoption, and measurable impact.
key_questions: Which AI opportunities are tied to real customer or service outcomes?
Where does work need redesign rather than task acceleration?
What evidence is needed before scaling in my service area?
How will value and quality be measured after launch?

risk_owner.title: Risk / Security / Responsible AI Owner
risk_owner.description: Focus on responsible AI, control evidence, safety testing, and auditability.

data_product_owner.title: Data Product Owner
data_product_owner.description: Focus on domain ownership, semantic quality, lineage, retrieval, and access patterns.

platform_product_owner.title: AI Platform Product Owner
platform_product_owner.description: Focus on internal platform adoption, developer experience, model access, evaluation, and observability.
